fact: US App Store rating counts (iTunes Search API, 2026-11-06): Runna 35,585; TrainerRoad 21,439; Zwift 21,480; TrainingPeaks 12,770; TriDot new app 34 plus Legacy TriDot 263; MOTTIV 71; Humango 21; Athletica 41. All tri-specific plan apps combined have under 450 US ratings.
Runna's triathlon plans cover only the running leg, with no swimming or cycling sessions, and Runna offers no duathlon plans as of Nov 2026.
Strava acquired Runna in April 2025 for an undisclosed sum; Runna continues as a separate app.
The joint Strava+Runna subscription is $149.99 per year, annual only.
Runna grew subscriptions 30x between December 2022 and December 2023 per RevenueCat's case study.
Runna had a team of more than 120 people across London and Boston around the acquisition and had raised over 8m GBP, so it was a venture-scale company, not a tiny team.

TriDot pricing (vendor page, fetched 2026-11-06): Lifestyle $14.99/mo for one sprint or Olympic race, Essentials $39/mo, Complete $99/mo, Premium Coached typically $249/mo; FitLogic marketed as the first AI-native endurance platform.

TriDot ended its Ironman 'Official Training Platform' sponsorship in early August 2025 citing unresolved business matters, stopped operating IRONMAN U, and launched its own ESCI certification; Ironman said the announcement came as a surprise.
MOTTIV pricing (vendor page, fetched 2026-11-06): free plan with one race, workout ads and no device/app connections; Premium $19.99/mo or $179.99/yr with a 30 day money back guarantee.
MOTTIV was founded in 2020 in Calgary by Taren Gesell (Triathlon Taren) and is reported at roughly 9-10 employees, seed stage.
Athletica.ai pricing (vendor page, fetched 2026-11-06): $19.90/mo, $99 per 6 months, $189/yr, 2 week trial with no credit card; supports triathlon, duathlon, running, cycling, rowing and HYROX.

Humango's App Store listing shows annual in-app purchases of $169.99 (Endurance) and $79.99 (Fitness); a 2024 review puts its top All-Star tier at about $29/mo with Olympic, half and full distance triathlon plans.
Humango signed a multi-year partnership with the Challenge Family race series.

80/20 Endurance individual triathlon plans start at $54.95 (Sprint), $64.95 (Olympic), $89.95 (Half) and $99.95 (Full); Team 80/20 membership is $16.58/mo paid annually and includes TrainingPeaks Premium.
TrainingPeaks raised annual Premium from $124.99 to $134.99 USD effective April 2, 2025 (official help center).
JOIN Cycling's official help center states it does not yet offer full triathlon training plans; swimming can only be logged and counts less toward training load; JOIN Running launched January 2025.
Zwift costs $19.99/mo and $199.99/yr after its 2024 price increase; TrainerRoad costs $21.99/mo or $209.99/yr.

watchOS 9 (2022) added the Multisport workout type with automatic swim/bike/run transition detection and a manual transitions option; the setting persists in current watchOS per Apple's user guide. Apple offers no triathlon training plan layer.
Per a Garmin forum report, Garmin Coach triathlon plans (free with a Garmin watch) top out at Olympic distance; no free Garmin 70.3 plan was found (user-generated source, verify in Garmin Connect).

Forum sentiment: TriDot Reddit feedback described as a mixed bag with ambassador-heavy advocacy; Humango's Hugo AI assistant called 'laughably bad'; Athletica praised for scientific transparency but called expensive for what it offers.
A 2024 Sports Medicine systematic review found polarized training superior to other intensity distributions only for VO2peak, with no superiority on other endurance performance outcomes
CSS test: all out 400m and 200m same day, CSS pace per 100m = (400m time minus 200m time)/2; test is invalid if the 200m pace is not faster than the 400m pace
FTP is estimated as 95 percent of maximal 20 minute average power (Coggan protocol); retest every 4 to 8 weeks
CTL and ATL are exponentially weighted moving averages of daily load with time constants 42 and 7 days; TSB = CTL minus ATL (Coggan Performance Management model built on Banister)
TSS is a live registered US trademark of TrainingPeaks, LLC (registered January 21, 2014); the portfolio also covers IF, NP, TP, TPU
intervals.icu names its TSS equivalent metric 'Load' specifically because TrainingPeaks trademarked TSS; the formula (1 hour at threshold = 100) is the same
GoldenCheetah (GPLv3) renamed TSS to BikeStress, IF to BikeIntensity, and NP to IsoPower in version 3.5
Runna shows a Plan Realignment prompt after more than 3 missed workouts or a missed week; single missed sessions are skipped or moved within the week and later workouts shift automatically
Runna's 'Not Feeling 100%' illness mode reduces plan difficulty or keeps only easy and long runs for up to 14 days

TriDot describes a four phase loop (Assess, Prescribe, Evaluate with TrainX score 1 to 100, Predict with RaceX) with FitLogic analyzing every logged workout and EnviroNorm normalizing for temperature, humidity, elevation, wind and terrain
Buist et al. GRONORUN RCT (N=532 novice runners): a 13 week graded program based on the 10 percent rule produced the same injury rate as a standard 8 week program (20.8 vs 20.3 percent)

Hottenrott et al. 2016 RCT (42 non elite marathoners): run/walk produced similar finish times to continuous running (about 4:14 vs 4:08, p=0.377) and less post race muscle pain and fatigue (p=0.006), with no reduction in cardiac stress markers
Hulin and Gabbett conceded their use of 'predict' for ACWR created a misconception; ACWR flags periods of risk rather than predicting injuries, and its validity has been formally challenged

Jeukendrup's triathlon nutrition guidance: 60 to 70 g carbohydrate per hour (up to 90 g/h if tolerable) at 5 to 8 percent concentration; glucose absorption via SGLT1 caps near 60 g/h and adding fructose raises the ceiling to about 90 g/h
Coaching heuristic weekly hour ranges: sprint 4 to 7, Olympic 6 to 10, 70.3 8 to 14, full distance 12 to 20, with peak weeks 20 to 30 percent above average and recovery weeks 30 to 40 percent below
Apple Guideline 1.2 requires UGC apps to ship content filtering, reporting, user blocking and published contact info, with removal until compliance
US providers hosting user content must report apparent CSAM to the NCMEC CyberTipline with evidence packaging and retention; obligations attach on actual knowledge
DSA exempts micro and small enterprises from online-platform-specific duties (Articles 20-22, transparency reports) but baseline hosting duties still apply
Supabase free tier: 500 MB database, 50,000 auth MAU, 1 GB file storage, 5 GB egress, projects pause after 7 idle days; Pro $25 per month
CloudKit public database free quota scales with users up to 10 TB storage and 200 TB monthly transfer (official 2015 figures; Apple publishes no current pricing page)
Chorus, Dick Costolo's funded social fitness app, shut down about 8 months after launch, blamed on hard-wired human behavior, not features
Strava's community, not tracking, is the moat: free users (over 95 percent of base) generate the engagement content and segments create direct network effects
Strava announced acquisition of Runna on April 17, 2025, undisclosed terms, keeping it standalone
Nov 2024 Strava API agreement bans displaying a user's Strava data to other users, AI/ML training, and analytics processing; users' own data display stays allowed; partners got 30 days
Strava upload API remains available: POST /api/v3/uploads accepts FIT, TCX, GPX (gzip ok) with activity:write scope
A copyright holder can relicense code they solely authored, but code combined with AGPL code cannot be relicensed, and modifications to AGPL components stay AGPL
4.3(b) spam rejections cite apps with the same feature set as existing App Store apps varying only in content; phone appeals have succeeded
FDA's General Wellness guidance (updated January 6, 2026) keeps exercise, aerobic fitness and endurance software outside medical device regulation if claims avoid disease references
Garmin Coach triathlon training plans are free in Garmin Connect for compatible watch owners
MOTTIV offers a $0 per month free plan covering sprint through full distance triathlon, paid upgrades from $14.99 per month billed annually
80/20 Endurance offers free 12-week triathlon maintenance plans on TrainingPeaks with code TRY8020
Runna costs $19.99 per month or $119.99 per year as of October 2026, with only week 1 of plans free; Strava bundle $149.99 per year
Removed from the public copy
iTunes Search API (US storefront, 2026-11-06): Taperline and Tricadence return zero software results; TriPace is taken by two existing triathlon apps

WorkoutKit (iOS 17+, watchOS 10+) lets third party apps create, preview, and sync scheduled workouts into the stock Apple Watch Workout app, where they appear in a dedicated space with the app's icon and name; four plan types: CustomWorkout, SingleGoalWorkout, PacerWorkout, SwimBikeRunWorkout

Custom pool swimming workouts (steps, goals, alerts) came to WorkoutKit in watchOS 11, with a new poolSwimDistanceWithTime goal and automatic pool-length distance conversion; open water custom workouts not included
SwimBikeRunWorkout init takes only an ordered activities list and displayName: no per-leg intervals, goals, or alerts in multisport plans
WorkoutScheduler has a maxAllowedScheduledWorkoutCount limit whose numeric value is not published in the docs
HealthKit multisport: HKWorkoutActivityType.swimBikeRun with transition activities and per-leg HKWorkoutActivity statistics, available iOS 16 / watchOS 9
HKWorkoutSwimmingLocationType distinguishes pool vs openWater swims (since iOS 10 / watchOS 3); per-lap stroke style via HKMetadataKeySwimmingStrokeStyle on lap events
Open water swim routes are readable via HKWorkoutRoute, but pool workouts expose no location; forum-reported DTS answer says no public API for indoor workout locations

Garmin Connect Developer Program has Personal (self-serve key, own data, pull only), Starter (apply, push only, includes Training API for pushing workouts to devices, limited capacity, no historical data), and Enterprise (negotiated) tiers; page says it supports individual developers to large companies

Garmin paused new developer program applications from around March 2026 with applicants left pending for 6+ months, following the 2025 Strava lawsuit and the July 2026 TrainingPeaks/TrainHeroic acquisitions

Strava API Agreement: 'Strava Data provided by a specific user can only be displayed or disclosed in your Developer Application to that user' and 'You may not create applications that compete with or replicate Strava functionality'
Strava default rate limits: 100 read requests per 15 minutes and 1,000 per day (200/2,000 overall); new apps start in Single Player Mode with athlete capacity of 1; increased access is not guaranteed
Wahoo Cloud API is OAuth 2.0 with workouts/plans/routes read-write scopes; access limited to approved requesters via developer portal application; Sandbox and Production are separate applications
COROS Partner API requires a registered company and an established user base, applied for via api@coros.com
CKShare limits shares to 100 participants, each needing an active iCloud account, and provides built-in access-request and user-blocking APIs (blockRequesters, blockedIdentities)
App Review 1.2 requires UGC apps to have content filtering, offensive-content reporting with timely responses, the ability to block abusive users, and published contact information
Guideline 5.1.1(v) requires in-app account deletion for any app that supports account creation, and guideline 5.1.3(ii) says apps may not store personal health information in iCloud

Apple defines 'collect' for privacy labels as transmitting data off device in a way that allows the developer or partners to access it beyond real-time request servicing; on-device-only data is not collected
CloudKit offers up to 1PB of public database storage, but Apple publishes no current request quota numbers; developers report throttling with retryAfter errors

Garmin program reportedly relaunched around October 2026 with a free instant Personal tier (own data, pull only, FIT files omitting VO2 max and recovery metrics) and a free Starter tier up to 1,000 users requiring approval

Suunto Cloud API access is reportedly granted only to companies/organizations, with the base Developer API tier limited to 10 calls/minute and 200 calls/week (third party summary, unverified against Suunto's own terms)
